items.title: Voice in/out for War Room agents
items.detail: Wire the dual-brain voice loops into the multi-agent thread so the owner can talk to the team, not just type. Stages 1-4 of Phase N build on the shipped Stage 0 text chat (warroom_messages).

items.title: Agent avatars
items.detail: Give each hive-* agent and Claude/CoWork a visible presence (talking-head pipeline already exists in AvatarStudio) so the War Room reads as a room of collaborators.

items.title: War Room as operations room
items.detail: Promote the War Room from a chat widget to the primary agentic operations surface — live agent presence, in-thread dispatch, and last-seen heartbeats already feeding it.

items.title: Full design->build->inspect->ship loop
items.detail: Advance QI_HiveApply beyond Phase 1 inbox-fallback: approved dispatch -> hive-builder worktree -> diff -> hive-inspector verdict -> commit, with the mechanical_inspector as the zero-cost gate.

items.title: Auto-close remediated inspector dispatches
items.detail: When the underlying compliance condition is fixed, automatically resolve the dispatch instead of leaving stale cards. Per-project disposition policy for recurring findings.

items.title: One dispatch per live finding
items.detail: Confirm the inspector raises exactly one dispatch per distinct finding per run (idempotency already in place) and verify it on the next scheduled run.

items.title: Populate the agent growth loop
items.detail: Have every dispatched hive-* agent log what worked / what to improve / patterns learned (agent_growth_log) so profiles accumulate and the team measurably improves over time.

items.title: Routine feature propagation runs
items.detail: Move feature_engine propagation from on-demand to a scheduled pass so a pattern built in one project is automatically surfaced to the others for adopt/adapt/skip.

items.title: Self-logging discipline for the Brain
items.detail: Close the gap where the Brain itself under-logs its own sessions; enforce SessionEnd logging via hooks so counts stay truthful.

items.title: Finish the Caddy qi.local front door
items.detail: Install QI_Caddy as a service so every app is reachable at <app>.qi.local with local HTTPS on the LAN; public access stays via Cloudflare named tunnels.

items.title: In-process module migration path
items.detail: Begin collapsing the highest-traffic cross-project HTTP calls (e.g. NEXUS /synthesize) into in-process function calls behind the same contract, proving the unified-platform thesis one call site at a time.

items.title: Service discovery from the registry
items.detail: Drive monitoring, CORS, and eventual in-app routing entirely from qi_registry.json so a stale registry can never silently break a module.

items.title: Per-product NSSM consent popups
items.detail: Ship the staged per-product NSSM copies (Maia_NSSM.exe, Naya_NSSM.exe, ...) so the UAC popup names the product. Armed for Sat 2026-06-27 via QI_NamingStandardize_Friday.

items.title: Scheduled-task window policy rollout
items.detail: Convert remaining tasks that pop console windows to conhost --headless launchers per the scheduled_tasks_window_policy.json.

items.title: Compliance-log retention
items.detail: Add rotation/summarisation for the compliance_log table (46k+ rows) so the audit trail stays fast and queryable.

items.title: Claude Work 4-way integration
items.detail: Complete the CoWork/Claude Code/QI Hive/the owner architecture so CoWork sessions report and receive dispatches through the Brain seamlessly.

items.title: OpenClaw / Kaze tighter coupling
items.detail: Surface OpenClaw agent (Kaze, Tasuke, etc.) activity in Mission Control and let dispatches reach the WSL agent fabric.

items.title: Public status / health beacon
items.detail: Optional read-only public status page (per Law 2 contract endpoints) for at-a-glance ecosystem health from anywhere.
